title: Why you should triple-check fluoride data in PFAS destruction and environmental fluorine balance
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00502G, Perspective
Mohamed Ateia, Fuhar Dixit
Accurate quantification of inorganic fluoride (F−) release is an essential metric for evaluating the efficacy of poly- and perfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS) degradation processes.
